The activity "Identify the top-performing sales representative in the Northeast region" requires access to sales performance data, regional sales metrics, and employee/representative rankings. None of the candidates provide these capabilities.

This is a pure sales analytics use case that the knowledge-graph walk surfaced only due to topical overlap with operations/change management, but none of the candidates actually fulfill the required capability.
